title: A very nice thick throw rug
text: A very nice thick throw rug. I absolutely love this rug! I’m ordering a second one for under my front door mat. I think the layered look is charming and inviting!

product_metadata.title: Homcomoda Cotton Plaid Runner Rug for Hallway Hand Woven Area Rug Runner Washable Buffalo Checkered Door Rug Durable Carpet Runner for Doorway Living Room Porch Farmhouse 23.6”x51.2”
features: PLAID RUG SIZE---The cotton runner rug for living room measures 23.6"x51.2"(60x130cm), perfect size to be placed in any place or high traffic area you want. Package includes 1 touch-friendly floor mat for entrance.

DURABLE FLOOR RUG---The black and white color of this living room rug runner is woven with high quality cotton-polyester blended threads in different colors instead of printed pattern, therefore, it is safe for your family and pets, durable, more delicate, and non fading.

EASY TO CLEAN&STORE--- You can vacuum it regularly, spot clean or blot out the dirty part, wash it with hand or washing machine, very easy to do, saving you time and energy. Besides, it can be folded or rolled into a compact size, really convenient to store and carry.

CLASSIC&FASHIONABLE---Combing checks together with the colors that will never be out of date, the simple but trendy bedroom rug can match your existing decor easily, and add more beautiful, elegant, chic, and cozy element as well as warmth and cleanness to your lovely home.

VERSATILE RUNNER RUG---The cotton area rug is not only perfect to be used as doormat, but also wonderful to be used as living room rug, laundry room rug, kitchen floor rug, bathroom rug, bedroom rug , kid’s room rug, sofa cover, etc.; it can be taken as a gift as well, very practical.
